column2: 僅影片 — 聲音在裝置上播放

column1: This theme uses an older format. Saving upgrades it to the current one.
column2: 此主題使用舊格式。儲存時會升級為目前格式。
要轉換的 PSP 主題

column1: Saved: name, author and description travel inside the .pfptheme. The updated date is set when you export.
column2: 已儲存：名稱、作者和說明會儲存在 .pfptheme 中。更新日期於匯出時設定。

column1: Each new wallpaper or video sets the accent. Pick a color to keep your own.
column2: 每次更換桌布或影片都會設定強調色。選擇一種顏色即可保留你自己的。

column1: Your accent stays when the wallpaper or video changes.
column2: 更換桌布或影片時，你的強調色維持不變。

column1: Titles and labels: the crossbar, list rows and status strip, and every screen.
column2: 標題和標籤：橫列、清單列、狀態列以及所有畫面。

column1: The preview always shows a frozen wave; the style plays on the device.
column2: 預覽一律顯示靜止的波浪；樣式會在裝置上播放。

column1: None — the theme leaves the device lock screen alone
column2: 無 — 主題不更動裝置的鎖定畫面

column1: A still only. The device crops it to its own screen, and only sets it when the user agrees on apply.
column2: 僅限靜態圖片。裝置會依自身螢幕裁切，且只在使用者套用時同意後才設定。

column1: Older launchers ignore these and show plain text and icons.
column2: 較舊的啟動器會忽略這些設定，顯示一般文字和圖示。

column1: Preview only — never saved in the theme. Remembered on this computer.
column2: 僅供預覽 — 不會儲存到主題中。會記在這台電腦上。

column1: Use my layout in the preview
column2: 在預覽中使用我的版面

column1: Select a slot to see it at real size, replace it, or export its template.
column2: 選取一個欄位即可以實際大小檢視、取代或匯出其範本。

column1: Drop an image file (png, gif, jpg, bmp, webp) onto any slot to replace its icon.
column2: 將圖片檔（png、gif、jpg、bmp、webp）拖曳到任一欄位即可取代其圖示。

column1: Anything you leave empty keeps the built-in sound. Clips must fit each row's cap.
column2: 留空的項目會保留內建音效。音訊片段必須符合每列的上限。

column1: Choose the built-in sequence or your own MP4 for each.
column2: 為每一項選擇內建序列或你自己的 MP4。

column1: Fix the items marked ✕ before exporting.
column2: 匯出前請修正標有 ✕ 的項目。

column1: A preview image of the finished theme is rendered when you export and shows as its thumbnail in the launcher's theme gallery.
column2: 匯出時會產生成品主題的預覽圖，並在啟動器的主題庫中顯示為縮圖。
